data.name: Huzaimah
data.gender_notes: Huzaimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: في اللغة العربية، اسم حُزَامَة يعكس معاني الشجاعة والعزيمة والأمل. يُفضل استخدامه لأسماء الأطفال المسلمين ويُشجع القيم العربية والإسلامية. The name Huzaimah carries the meaning “Blooming, Abundant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Huzaimah usually hope their child will grow to embody blooming, abundant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Huzaimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blooming, Abundant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Huzaimah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Huzaimah holds a beautiful connection to nature, as it is derived from the Arabic word "hawz" which means "garden" or "source of water". In the Islamic context, this name holds deep cultural significance as it refers to someone who is constantly nurturing and blooming like a beautiful garden. It is an evocative name that reflects the love and appreciation for the natural world and the concept of growth and development.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Huzaimah holds a deeper meaning as it represents someone who is in a state of continuous growth and development, like a garden that is tended and nurtured. In Islamic teachings, this name is used as a reminder to always strive for self-improvement, to cultivate one's character and soul, and to seek knowledge and wisdom like a lifetime source of water. It is a name that inspires us to live a meaningful and fulfilling life, always in pursuit of growth and progress, both in this world and in the hereafter.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Huzaimah means "shining light" or "radiant one" in Arabic, symbolizing an individual who illuminates the path for others with their knowledge, wisdom, and guidance.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah (The Beginning and the End) - Volume 7 The name Huzaimah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: One of the Ansar (Helpers) of Madinah who embraced Islam early. He was known as Huzaifah bin Al-Yaman, but he was called Huzaimah after the migration to Madinah. He was the cousin of Ali ibn Abi Talib and the standard-bearer of Ali's army during the Battle of Uhud.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Tabari's Tarikh al-Rusul wa al-Muluk (History of Prophets and Kings) - Volume 5 The name Huzaimah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Huzaimah ibn Hizam was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad. He was a man of great wealth and was among the first to embrace Islam. When the Muslims migrated from Mecca to Medina, Huzaimah was among those who were given the title 'Al-Ashiq al-Abi' (The Loving Old Man), due to his advanced age and his deep love for the Prophet and Islam.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Huzaimah, which originated from the Arabic language and has historical significance in Islamic tradition, is gaining modern usage and popularity across various platforms among the Muslim community. On social media, it is seen as a unique, beautiful, and meaningful name for children, often accompanied by photos and posts about naming ceremonies or baby showers. On marriage websites, it is a search term used by individuals looking for potential partners with this name as a part of their identity. In educational institutions, it is a name that students may come across in textbooks, lessons, or classes that study Islamic history and traditions. Overall, the name Huzaimah reflects the importance of tradition and identity within the Muslim community, and its usage across these platforms serves as a reminder of the rich cultural heritage of Islam.
